name: Teamtailor
summary: Applicant tracking system with career sites.

flows.title: Create and publish a job
steps: Go to the Jobs tab and click the pink + button.
Add an internal Title, and optionally select a Job template as the base.
Add the Job ad title and Job description, which are required to save the job, and assign the Department, Role and Location.
Under Application, choose which personal info fields and questions are optional or mandatory.
Publish the job from the lower menu on the right, or click Save draft to finish later. Users who cannot publish see Ready to publish, which notifies those who can.

flows.title: Add a candidate
steps: Go to the candidate database under Candidates and click the pink plus button at the top right (+ Add candidates).
Enter the candidate's details, such as name, email, department or role and locations, or parse them from the candidate's resume.
Optionally add the candidate to one of the open recruitment processes.
Click Add candidates. The candidate appears in the database with the status Sourced.

flows.title: Comment on a candidate
steps: On the candidate card, click Comment in the action bar or Comments in the sidebar.
Choose whether it is a comment on the job application or on the candidate. To limit who sees it, click the globe icon and select the users.
Write the comment. Type @ and select team members to notify them.
